title: AnsysEM greenfield evidence through one validated Runtime plan
prompt: Use exactly one EDA Bridge Runtime tool call: eda.run_plan on connection '{{ANSYS_CONNECTION}}'. Its purpose is 'Benchmark one-call AnsysEM greenfield evidence contract'. Supply exactly three ordered typed steps. Step create: purpose 'Create disposable AnsysEM plan evaluation project', operation project.create, idempotency_key='{{ANSYS_CREATE_KEY}}', payload project='{{ANSYS_PROJECT}}', design='RuntimePlanEvalLayout', version='2026.1', profile='aedt-2026r1-display4', display=':4.0', redact_paths=true, and wait timeout_ms=90000 poll_interval_ms=1000. Step inspect: purpose 'Verify persisted AnsysEM plan evaluation bundle', operation project.inspect, payload with the same project/version/profile/display and redact_paths=true, and the same wait settings. Step image: purpose 'Export verified AnsysEM plan evaluation image', operation layout.export_image, payload project='{{ANSYS_PROJECT}}', design='RuntimePlanEvalLayout', version='2026.1', profile='aedt-2026r1-display4', display=':4.0', output='{{ANSYS_IMAGE}}', width=800, height=600, redact_paths=true, and the same wait settings. Do not call capabilities separately, replay jobs, use shell/files/documentation/GUI, mutate after creation, solve, or use customer data. From the three actual terminal step responses return only compact JSON with status='passed', created=true, bundle_complete=true, image_verified=true, design_count, and validation_count.
